purpose: Document first-party local registry context and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review for Fuqing, China.
assessment: Fuqing's official Natural Resources and Planning Bureau is a local registry/cadastre custodian. Official material describes unified real-estate registration, cadastral investigation, real-estate surveying, and results application. Official Fuqing and Fujian sources describe municipal One Map/public geospatial platforms and a Tian地图·Fuqing service, but bounded anonymous routes did not return a current viewer configuration or safe parcel feature response.
registryAssessment: Local registry/cadastre custodian verified: 福清市自然资源和规划局, including its 不动产登记和交易中心. The public geospatial platform is official bureau material, but it is not by itself evidence of an open parcel-feature API.
